newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish shares closes 2.74 pct lower.
newsitem.headline: Turkish shares closes 2.74 pct lower.

text.p: 1305 GMT - Turkish shares closed at 1,955 on Monday, down 2.74 percent or 55 points from Friday's close on profit taking in a rangebound trade.
The index fell 3.53 percent in the afternoon, before rising at the close. The index moved in bewteen 1,939-2,018 levels during the day.
Daily volume fell to 20.57 trillion lira ($132 million) from Friday's 25.83 trillion lira ($167 million).
